about_the_game:
Good Children Say Grace is a first-person psychological horror adventure set on a remote Soviet island in the 1980s.

Dear Diary,

Day 1: The ship arrived with Amelia. My new sister. Sacrificed in the church shortly after.

Night 1: Amelia kneeled before a crucified chicken in my home. No memory of being killed.

Day 2: Naval blockade... No more supplies for the island.

Day 730: The food ran out :(

The red egg watches.

IT REQUIRES SUSTENANCE.

  • First-person / 2.5D exploration with branching narratives

  • Story-rich nonlinear gameplay

  • Dialogue and movement-based decision systems

  • Psychological horror focused on family, love, boredom, hunger, and loneliness

  • Multiple routes and endings based on your choices

content_descriptors.notes: Good Children Say Grace is a psychological horror game not intended for all audiences. It contains depictions of violence, death, family dysfunction, poverty, emotional manipulation, psychological trauma, and non-graphic depictions of suicide.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (Quad-core, 2.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB with Vulkan support
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: My parents sacrificed an orphan to the red egg. She came back home that night. How will the two of us survive the hunger? Good Children Say Grace.
